name: @kiwa-test/desktop
description: Desktop test harness for kiwa v0.1 — 3 axis (Electron + Tauri + Webview) unified as target-neutral state machine。 Electron (main process + renderer + IPC) / Tauri (invoke command + event listen + window mgmt) / Webview (bridge + preload script + context isolation)。 v1.56 で kiwa 縦深化 pair 第 14 新規 base pair 導入、 42 package 到達、 v2.0 milestone Desktop adapter goal 先取り実装。

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
